UNDER THE HOOD

Small model. Inspectable evidence.

A one-class nearest-neighbour model learns from your reference windows. It compares average flow, lower-quartile flow, active-minute ratio and variability. A score above 1 flags a pattern for review.

Experimental prototype: no field validation, leak diagnosis, live hardware connection or measured water savings.

01Learn routine useFit robust scales and a distance threshold from the reference.
02Find unfamiliar patternsCompare each complete 15-minute window to its three nearest reference windows.
03Keep a human in the loopInspect readings and save your decision in an exportable evidence packet.
